description: Read-only access to the published statistics of the example organization. Every data response carries the series identifier, unit, release date, source URL, licence, and citation.

tools.name: search_series
tools.description: Search the published series by words in the name, definition, or keywords. Returns up to `limit` matches with idno, name, measurement_unit, periodicity, and coverage, ranked by relevance. Use this first when the series identifier is unknown.

query.description: Words from the user's question, in any supported language

limit.description: Maximum number of matches, 1 to 20; default 5

tools.name: get_series_metadata
tools.description: Return the full record of one series in the World Bank indicator schema: definition, methodology, universe, unit, periodicity, breaks, limitations, licence, and citation requirement. Use this before interpreting values.

tools.name: get_observations
tools.description: Return the published values of one series for a reference area and a period range, with the unit, the observation status of each value, the release date, the source URL, the licence, and the citation. Values are the official figures; no estimation is performed.

ref_area.description: Code from the reference area code list; NAT for the national total

start_period.description: First period, inclusive, ISO 8601 or SDMX period such as 2024 or 2025-Q1

tools.name: list_code_values
tools.description: Return the codes and labels of a code list (reference areas, sexes, age groups) so that a request can use valid codes. Use this to resolve a place name to its code.

codelist.description: Code list identifier, for example REF_AREA

language.description: Label language, ISO 639 code; default en

resources.description: How to use the tools: search first, read metadata before interpreting, request codes from the code lists, cite the source URL and release date in every answer.
Upcoming releases and the latest release of each series.
